requirement: The site agent is told to change only what was asked, asks before writing anything shared, and is told about a change nobody asked for

oracle.ref: PR #1479 (fix); fix evidence: Staff report 20/10/2026: 'when Tracy fixes one place it often breaks another'; no scope rule, shared records written without asking, visual check had no verdict for unasked changes
oracle.invariant: S1: every session's context carries the SCOPE line; all:true only when asked. S2: each asks first, nothing sent. S3: refused BODY_WIDE, nothing written. S4: exactly one notice telling the agent to put back just that.
oracle.productSourcesScope: file-level: the files the case imports, reads or runs (declaration line, or the first code line); the invariant is exercised through them, the executed assertion is the case command

writes: run dir under QA_ARTIFACT_ROOT: logs/, tmp/<case> (the child TMPDIR, removed after the run)
